summary: This mishnah lists people who make a korban pasul if they catch its blood, and wrong ways of putting the blood on the mizbeach. In these cases the korban is pasul, but there is no kares for eating it.

chunks.en: All korbanos whose blood was caught by a non-Kohen,
chunks.st: With regard to all slaughtered offerings, if the one who collected their blood was a non-priest;

words.note: Someone who is not a Kohen.

chunks.en: or by a Kohen in mourning, or one who toveled today,
chunks.st: or a priest who was an acute mourner, i.e., one whose relative has died and has not yet been buried; or one who was ritually impure who immersed that day
chunks.stMore: and is waiting for nightfall for the purification process to be completed;

words.note: A Kohen whose close relative died and is not yet buried.
He went to the mikvah today and becomes tahor only at night.

chunks.en: or a Kohen missing his special clothes, or one who still has to bring his korban to finish becoming tahor,
chunks.st: or one who has not yet brought an atonement offering, e.g., a zav or leper after the seventh day of the purification process; or a priest lacking the requisite priestly vestments;

words.note: The special clothes a Kohen wears for the avodah.
He still has to bring a korban to finish becoming tahor.

chunks.en: or one who did not wash his hands and feet,
chunks.st: or one who did not wash his hands and feet
chunks.stMore: from the water in the Basin prior to performing the Temple service;

chunks.en: or a Kohen without a bris, or one who is tamei,
chunks.st: or an uncircumcised priest; or a ritually impure priest;

chunks.en: or one sitting, or standing on top of vessels,
chunks.st: or if the one who collected the blood was sitting; or if he was standing not on the floor of the Temple but upon vessels,

chunks.en: or on top of an animal,
chunks.st: or upon an animal,

chunks.en: or on top of his friend's feet,
chunks.st: or upon the feet of another,

chunks.en: made it pasul. If he caught the blood with his left hand,
chunks.st: he has disqualified the offering. If he collected the blood with his left hand,

chunks.en: he made it pasul. Rabbi Shimon says it is kosher.
chunks.st: he disqualified the blood for offering. In this last case, Rabbi Shimon deems it fit.

chunks.en: If the blood spilled on the floor and he gathered it up,
chunks.st: If the blood spilled on the floor before the priest managed to collect it into a vessel, and the priest then collected it from the floor into a vessel,

chunks.en: it is pasul. If he put the blood on the ramp,
chunks.st: it is disqualified. If the priest placed the blood upon the ramp leading up to the altar,

words.note: The ramp the Kohanim walked up to reach the top of the mizbeach.

chunks.en: or on a part of the mizbeach that is not over its base,
chunks.st: or if he placed it on the wall of the altar in an area that is not opposite the base
chunks.stMore: of the altar, i.e., in those parts of the altar where there is no foundation;

words.note: The bottom step of the mizbeach, which did not go all the way around.

chunks.en: or he put blood that goes below
chunks.st: or if he placed the blood that is to be placed below
chunks.stMore: the red line that runs along the middle of the altar, e.g., the blood of a burnt offering,

words.note: Below the red line around the middle of the mizbeach.

chunks.en: above, or blood that goes above,
chunks.st: above the red line, or if he placed the blood that is to be placed above the red line, e.g., the blood of a sin offering,

chunks.en: below; or blood that goes inside,
chunks.st: below the red line; or if he placed the blood that is to be placed inside
chunks.stMore: the Sanctuary, i.e., on the golden altar or in the Holy of Holies,

words.note: Inside the Heichal, on the golden mizbeach or in the Kodesh HaKodashim.

chunks.en: outside; or blood that goes outside,
chunks.st: outside the Sanctuary on the external altar, or if he placed the blood that is to be placed outside

chunks.en: inside, it is pasul, but there is no kares.
chunks.st: the Sanctuary inside the Sanctuary, in all these cases the offering is disqualified. Nevertheless, there is no liability for karet for one who partakes of these offerings.

words.note: A punishment from Heaven for very serious sins.

summary: If someone shechts a korban planning to do its jobs outside the Beis HaMikdash, it is pasul. If he plans to do them the next day, after their time, it becomes piggul, and one who eats it gets kares.

chunks.en: One who shechts the korban planning to throw its blood
chunks.st: With regard to one who slaughters the offering with intent to sprinkle its blood

chunks.en: outside, or some of its blood outside,
chunks.st: outside the Temple or to sprinkle part of its blood outside the Temple,

words.note: Outside the courtyard of the Beis HaMikdash.

chunks.en: to burn its parts for the mizbeach outside,
chunks.st: to burn its sacrificial portions outside

words.note: The fats and parts of the korban burned on the mizbeach.

chunks.en: or some of those parts outside,
chunks.st: the Temple or to burn part of its sacrificial portions outside the Temple,

chunks.en: to eat its meat outside, or an olive-size
chunks.st: to partake of its meat outside the Temple or to partake of an olive-bulk

words.note: About the size of an olive; the smallest amount that counts as eating.

chunks.en: of its meat outside, or to eat an olive-size
chunks.st: of its meat outside the Temple, or to partake of an olive-bulk

chunks.en: of the skin of the tail outside,
chunks.st: of the skin of the tail outside the Temple,

words.note: The fatty tail of a sheep.

chunks.en: it is pasul, but there is no kares.
chunks.st: in all of these cases the offering is disqualified, and there is no liability for karet for one who partakes of it.

chunks.en: If he planned to throw its blood tomorrow, or
chunks.st: But if one had intent to sprinkle its blood the next day

chunks.en: some of its blood tomorrow,
chunks.st: or part of its blood the next day,

chunks.en: to burn its parts for the mizbeach tomorrow, or
chunks.st: to burn its sacrificial portions the next day or

chunks.en: some of those parts tomorrow,
chunks.st: to burn part of its sacrificial portions the next day,

chunks.he: לֶאֱכֹל בְּשָׂרוֹ לְמָחָר אוֹ כַזַּיִת מִבְּשָׂרוֹ
chunks.en: to eat its meat tomorrow, or an olive-size of its meat
chunks.st: to partake of its meat the next day or to partake of an olive-bulk of its meat

chunks.he: לְמָחָר אוֹ כַּזַּיִת מֵעוֹר הָאַלְיָה לְמָחָר,
chunks.en: tomorrow, or an olive-size of the skin of the tail tomorrow,
chunks.st: the next day, or to partake of an olive-bulk of the skin of the tail the next day,

chunks.en: it is piggul, and one who eats it gets kares.
chunks.st: the offering is piggul, and one is liable to receive karet for burning or partaking of it.

words.note: A korban ruined by planning to eat or offer it after its time.

summary: The rule: if he plans, during one of the four jobs, to eat or burn the korban in the wrong place, it is pasul. If he plans to do it after its time, it is piggul, as long as everything else was done right.

chunks.en: This is the rule:
chunks.st: This is the principle:

chunks.en: Anyone who shechts, catches the blood, carries it, or throws it,
chunks.st: With regard to anyone who slaughters the animal, or who collects the blood, or who conveys the blood, or who sprinkles the blood,

chunks.en: planning to eat something that is usually eaten,
chunks.st: with intent to partake of an item whose typical manner is such that one partakes of it, e.g., the meat of the offering,

chunks.en: or to burn something that is usually burned,
chunks.st: or to burn an item whose typical manner is such that one burns it on the altar,

chunks.en: outside its place,
chunks.st: if his intent was to partake of or to burn the measure of an olive-bulk outside its designated area,

chunks.en: it is pasul, but there is no kares.
chunks.st: the offering is disqualified, but there is no liability for karet for burning or partaking of it.

chunks.en: After its time,
chunks.st: If his intent was to do so beyond its designated time,

chunks.en: it is piggul, and one who eats it gets kares,
chunks.st: the offering is piggul and one is liable to receive karet for burning or partaking of it,

chunks.en: as long as the part that makes it allowed is offered the right way.
chunks.st: provided that the permitting factor, the blood, is sacrificed in accordance with its mitzva.

words.note: The blood, which makes the korban allowed once it is thrown.

summary: When is the blood "offered the right way" so the korban can become piggul? Only when the only wrong thought was about time. If there was also a thought about the wrong place, or the wrong purpose, it is not piggul.

chunks.en: How is the part that makes it allowed offered the right way?
chunks.st: How is the permitting factor sacrificed in accordance with its mitzva?

chunks.en: If he shechted without saying anything,
chunks.st: If one slaughtered the animal in silence with no specific intent,

chunks.en: and caught, carried and threw the blood planning to eat it after its time;
chunks.st: and he collected and conveyed and sprinkled the blood with intent to burn or partake of the offering beyond its designated time;

chunks.en: or he shechted planning for after its time,
chunks.st: or if one slaughtered it with intent to burn or partake of the offering beyond its designated time,

chunks.en: and caught, carried and threw without saying anything;
chunks.st: and he collected and conveyed and sprinkled the blood in silence;

chunks.en: or he shechted,
chunks.st: or if one slaughtered

chunks.en: and caught, carried and threw, all planning for after its time,
chunks.st: the animal and collected and conveyed and sprinkled the blood with intent to burn or partake of the offering beyond its designated time,

chunks.en: that is when the part that makes it allowed is offered the right way.
chunks.st: that is the case where one sacrifices the permitting factor in accordance with its mitzva.

chunks.en: How is it not offered the right way?
chunks.st: How is the permitting factor not sacrificed in accordance with its mitzva?

chunks.en: If he shechted planning for outside its place,
chunks.st: If one slaughtered the animal with intent to burn it or partake of it outside its designated area,

chunks.en: and caught, carried and threw planning for after its time;
chunks.st: and he collected and conveyed and sprinkled the blood with intent to burn it or partake of it beyond its designated time;

chunks.en: or he shechted planning for after its time,
chunks.st: or if one slaughtered the animal with intent to burn it or partake of it beyond its designated time,

chunks.en: and caught, carried and threw planning for outside its place;
chunks.st: and collected and conveyed and sprinkled the blood with intent to burn it or partake of it outside its designated area;

chunks.en: or he shechted,
chunks.st: or if one slaughtered

chunks.en: caught, carried,
chunks.st: the animal and collected and conveyed

chunks.en: and threw, all planning for outside its place.
chunks.st: and sprinkled the blood with intent to burn it or partake of it outside its designated area,
chunks.stMore: these are cases in which the permitting factor is not sacrificed in accordance with the mitzva. Similarly,

chunks.en: Or a korban Pesach or chatas shechted for the wrong purpose,
chunks.st: in the case of the Paschal offering and the sin offering that one slaughtered not for their sake,

chunks.en: and he caught, carried and threw planning for after its time;
chunks.st: and one collected and conveyed and sprinkled the blood with intent to burn it or partake of it beyond its designated time;

chunks.en: or he shechted planning for after its time,
chunks.st: or if one slaughtered the Paschal offering or sin offering with intent to burn it or partake of it beyond its designated time,

chunks.en: and caught, carried and threw for the wrong purpose;
chunks.st: and he collected and conveyed and sprinkled the blood not for their sake;

chunks.en: or he shechted,
chunks.st: or that one slaughtered

chunks.en: caught, carried,
chunks.st: the Paschal offering or sin offering and collected and conveyed

chunks.en: and threw, all for the wrong purpose,
chunks.st: and sprinkled their blood not for their sake,

chunks.he: זֶה הוּא שֶׁלֹּא קָרַב הַמַּתִּיר כְּמִצְוָתוֹ:
chunks.en: that is when the part that makes it allowed is not offered the right way.
chunks.st: that is the case of an offering whose permitting factor is not sacrificed in accordance with its mitzva.

summary: If he planned to eat some of the korban outside its place and some after its time, it is pasul but not piggul. Rabbi Yehudah says it depends on which thought came first. Eating and burning half-sizes do not add up.

chunks.en: If he planned to eat an olive-size outside and an olive-size tomorrow,
chunks.st: If one performed one of the sacrificial rites with the intent to eat an olive-bulk outside its designated area and an olive-bulk the next day,

chunks.en: or an olive-size tomorrow and an olive-size outside,
chunks.st: or an olive-bulk the next day and an olive-bulk outside its designated area,

chunks.he: כַּחֲצִי זַיִת בַּחוּץ וְכַחֲצִי זַיִת לְמָחָר,
chunks.en: or half an olive-size outside and half an olive-size tomorrow,
chunks.st: or half an olive-bulk outside its designated area and half an olive-bulk the next day,

chunks.he: כַּחֲצִי זַיִת לְמָחָר וְכַחֲצִי זַיִת בַּחוּץ,
chunks.en: or half an olive-size tomorrow and half an olive-size outside,
chunks.st: or half an olive-bulk the next day and half an olive-bulk outside its designated area,

chunks.en: it is pasul, but there is no kares.
chunks.st: the offering is disqualified and there is no liability for karet for burning or partaking of it.

chunks.en: Rabbi Yehudah said,
chunks.st: Rabbi Yehuda said

chunks.en: this is the rule:
chunks.st: that this is the principle:

chunks.he: אִם מַחֲשֶׁבֶת הַזְּמָן קָדְמָה לְמַחֲשֶׁבֶת הַמָּקוֹם,
chunks.en: If the thought about time came before the thought about place,
chunks.st: In any case where the intent with regard to the time preceded the intent with regard to the area,

chunks.en: it is piggul, and one who eats it gets kares.
chunks.st: the offering is piggul and one is liable to receive karet for burning or partaking of it.

chunks.he: וְאִם מַחֲשֶׁבֶת הַמָּקוֹם קָדְמָה לְמַחֲשֶׁבֶת הַזְּמָן,
chunks.en: But if the thought about place came before the thought about time,
chunks.st: And if the intent with regard to the area preceded the intent with regard to the time,

chunks.en: it is pasul, but there is no kares.
chunks.st: the offering is disqualified and there is no liability for karet for burning or partaking of it.

chunks.en: But the Sages say, both this and that
chunks.st: And the Rabbis say: In both this case and that case,

chunks.en: are pasul, but there is no kares.
chunks.st: the offering is disqualified and there is no liability for karet for burning or partaking of it.

chunks.he: לֶאֱכֹל כַּחֲצִי זַיִת וּלְהַקְטִיר כַּחֲצִי זַיִת,
chunks.en: If he planned to eat half an olive-size and burn half an olive-size,
chunks.st: If his intent was to eat half an olive-bulk and to burn half an olive-bulk not at the appropriate time or in the appropriate area,

chunks.en: it is kosher, because eating and burning do not add up together.
chunks.st: the offering is fit because eating and burning do not join together.
